datasets.title: South Sudan Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2020
datasets.description: South Sudan Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/south_sudan_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2020, classifying geographic areas by acute food insecurity phase. The spatial data was compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML files representing the current food security situation across South Sudan administrative units.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerations, providing geographic classifications of acute food insecurity phases across South Sudan.
